facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Mr. Fogg made a big bet. He said he could travel the world in 80 days. Everyone thought it was impossible. Fogg made a bold bet.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Phileas Fogg was a very precise English gentleman. One day at his club, he bet his friends he could circle the globe in 80 days. He risked all his money on this daring challenge. His friends laughed, but Fogg was completely serious. Fogg made a bold bet. With careful planning, Fogg believed anything was possible.
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: Phileas Fogg was known throughout London as the most punctual and methodical gentleman in England. One evening at the Reform Club, a discussion about a new railway led to an extraordinary wager. Fogg calmly announced that he could travel around the entire world in just eighty days. His fellow club members were astonished and bet twenty thousand pounds that he would fail. Fogg made a bold bet. However, Fogg was not a man who made decisions lightly or without careful calculation. Because he had studied every railway timetable and steamship schedule, he was confident in his plan. That very evening, Fogg packed his bag and prepared to leave London on the greatest journey of his life.
